line_items.reasoning: Q4 revenue came in at $1.407B, exceeding the high end of guidance ($1.331B) by over 900 basis points and delivering 70% YoY growth vs. the guided ~61% YoY; full-year revenue also surpassed the raised $4.396B–$4.400B range.
Full-year U.S. commercial revenue reached $1.465B (109% YoY growth), exceeding the 'in excess of $1.433B' (at least 104% YoY) guidance raised last quarter.
Q4 adjusted operating income of $798M at a 57% margin exceeded the guided $695M–$699M range by approximately $100M and 500 basis points, a clear and significant beat.
Full-year adjusted free cash flow of $2.27B exceeded the raised guidance range of $1.9B–$2.1B, and the full-year Rule of 40 score of 106% surpassed the guided 102%.
